name: Tụ lực lưỡi đao (xanh)
desc: blue energy that gathers in a weapon: a source ignites at the hilt, a front rises along the blade to the tip, then bright pulses keep running hilt to tip; discreet (it is a status); flat tiers (deep, blue, ice, white), two see-through bands and a two-scale glow around the blade, a few rising specks drawn on twos; it does not fade out, so it can run through a skill
